doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Shade's thumb and finger picking
summary: Shade explains he plays with his thumb and lead finger rather than a pick, which breaks strings.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Well, the reason I lose my thumb, I never play with a pick to do no good. I used to play with my thumb all the time. I get as much out of my thumb as I do a pick. It breaks too many strings.
And you pick with your first finger, too, sometimes, huh?
Sure, I pick with my lead finger on my little lead.
You use your other fingers any?
I don't have to. Then I just have to.
Yeah, well, it sounds fine that way.
